root_idea.summary: The root develops from two closely related bases: the ear as the organ of hearing, and knowledge or information received through hearing.
root_idea.development: From hearing come listening, heeding, and becoming informed; the same semantic field extends to informing or proclaiming, permission and authorization, and the ear or ear-shaped appendage.

senses.definition: to listen to, heed, and submit to what is heard
senses.usage_conditions: Used of listening attentively or obediently; in the Quranic image of the earth listening to its Lord, the sense includes compliance and submission.

senses.definition: to know, become informed, or be apprised of something
senses.usage_conditions: Constructed with بِـ for becoming informed or certain of a matter; the Quranic construction فَأْذَنُوا بِـ means to be informed or assured of the matter announced.

senses.definition: to permit, allow, or give leave
senses.usage_conditions: Used with لِـ or فِي for granting permission. Passive forms express being granted permission. The related construction أَذِنَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ can mean obtaining permission for someone from another person.

senses.definition: to announce, proclaim, or call out publicly
senses.usage_conditions: The Form II causative/intensive usage makes information known publicly; it is used for proclaiming a matter among people, including proclaiming the pilgrimage.

senses.definition: to inform, notify, or announce something to someone
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive informing construction, commonly with بِـ or a direct object; it makes a matter known to its addressee.
Used for a forceful or assured pronouncement, especially a declaration presented as certain to take effect.
The requester seeks leave from an authority or person, commonly to enter, depart, or undertake an action; the object of the request may be expressed directly or with فِي.
Denotes the allowance or release of an action. With God as possessor of the permission, it can include His command, will, or enabling authorization rather than human leave alone.

senses.definition: knowledge or awareness conjoined with will or command
senses.usage_conditions: A specialized Quran-attested interpretive use in which knowledge is not bare awareness but knowledge accompanied by will, command, or effective authorization; it is therefore narrower than ordinary عِلْمٌ.
A nominal form denoting the act or result of making a matter publicly known.

senses.definition: the ear, the organ of hearing
senses.usage_conditions: The ordinary anatomical noun, with plural آذَانٌ.

senses.definition: a person who listens to and accepts whatever is said
senses.usage_conditions: An epithet applied to a person regarded as excessively receptive or credulous; in the Quran it is answered by the qualification أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ, a hearer of what is good for you.

senses.definition: one who announces or calls out a matter
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of أَذَّنَ; in the Quranic occurrences it denotes an announcer who calls out publicly, not specifically a caller to prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to desire eagerly or long for food after perceiving its smell
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction with لِرَائِحَةِ الطَّعَامِ; the desire is prompted by sensing the food's odor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to strike, hit, or hurt someone's ear
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive physical use distinct from listening and permission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to suffer a complaint or pain in the ear
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a person whose ear is affected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to twist, wring, strike, or flip someone's ear
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes striking the ear with a finger; the usage is also associated with dismissing someone from a limited watering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to repel or send someone away, especially from drinking water
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived, figurative extension of the ear-striking usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to fit a sandal with an ear-like strap or loop
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of attaching the part called أُذُنٌ to a sandal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to announce or speak of sending away one's camels
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression referring to announcing the release or departure of camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to prevent, forbid, or repel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare or figurative Form IV usage reported as an extension of the root's permission and notification senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to please or delight someone, causing him to listen to it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative usage in which what is heard gives pleasure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to give notice of an impending condition or change
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of a building indicating its coming collapse; also of herbage beginning to dry and grain putting forth its leaves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to know or become informed of something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or reflexive Form IV use equivalent to becoming apprised or certain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a sincere adviser, intimate, or special friend
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the person who listens closely; distinct from the Quranic epithet for a credulous hearer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an ear-shaped appendage or projecting part
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied by comparison to appendages of the heart and to the wings or feathers of an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a handle or loop-shaped grip of a vessel or bucket
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical use based on the shape of the external ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a sharp, ear-shaped part that emerges from certain plants and later falls away
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the specified plant growths because of their form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a leaf of a tree or of grain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the leaf called خُوصَة of the ثُّمَام.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a young camel, sheep, or goat
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation based on resemblance to the leaf-like خُوصَة of the ثُّمَام.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a piece or kind of straw
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also function as a collective designation for such pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the call announcing the time of prayer
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In later conventional usage it can also denote the إقامة, the notification to attend the prayer, and أَذَانَانِ can refer to both the call and the إقامة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an animal possessing an external ear
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with an animal having only an ear-hole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who makes known, informs, notifies, or announces
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or quasi-participial form used for an informer or notifier.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a responsible or answerable person, surety, or guarantor
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional synonym of كَفِيلٌ or زَعِيمٌ in the sense of one who undertakes responsibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place reached by the call from every direction
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place is so called when the أَذَان reaches it from all sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: large-eared or long-eared
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or to certain animals, including camels and sheep or goats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who hears everything that is said
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vulgar or colloquial derivative of the ear epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who permits or allows; hence a doorkeeper or chamberlain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occupational sense arises from the person who grants access or permission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who or something that indicates or gives notice of a matter
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an impression indicating goodness; in vulgar usage, also of women who announce times of festivity and rejoicing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: herbage beginning to dry, or partly dried wood retaining some moisture
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use for vegetation or wood in an intermediate state between freshness and complete dryness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place, generally a mosque turret, from which the time of prayer is announced
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for a tower or structure called مَنَارَةٌ or صَوْمَعَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who announces or chants the time of prayer
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The conventional religious occupation associated with the call to prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a slave authorized by his master to engage in trade
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal and commercial term, commonly understood with لَهُ after it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: having one's ear struck or hurt
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial use distinct from the legal sense of authorization.

cautions: The Form I QAC group contains multiple grammatical voices, aspects, and surface spellings; the senses are distinguished by lexical construction rather than by English gloss alone.
